title: tptable/1: the pathway of transformation products as a table (mzdraw::tptable)
description: The key table of `"out":"tptable"` (JSON) and of `"out":"tptable-csv"` (the same rows as CSV, the columns of `columns`, RFC 4180, LF line ends). Checked by crates/mzdraw/tests/tptable.rs and crates/mzdraw-wasm/tests/tptable.rs without a JSON Schema validator (none is a dependency): the key order (x-key-order, on the raw text), the 15 columns in order and that every value is a string are asserted by hand; the other constraints are documentation. Every value of a row is a string; an empty string is no value (never 0). Masses and m/z have 4 decimals (the formatter of Rust, ties to even); `ppm` 1 decimal. The masses come from the engine of mzLab through the bridge: without it (the plain replay) `engine` is false and the mass cells, `ppm` and `mass_diff` are empty. NORMAN-style, never NORMAN-ready: no NORMAN validator was run.

engine.description: Whether the engine of the masses was there.

rows.description: One row per structure and parent: a product with two parents has two rows, a root one row with `parent_id`, `form_diff` and `mass_diff` empty. In the order `tp:number` numbers the products in (setting `pathway.number`: layer then position, `mz`, `rt`), roots included; structures no anchored arrow touches come last in the order of their first atom; a drawing with no anchored arrow is in the order of the first atom. At most 1,000 structures and 15,000 atoms (`error.draw2.tpTableSize`).

tp_id.x-source: data field TP_ID of the structure, as typed (reserved name of tp-08)

parent_id.x-source: TP_ID of the structure an anchored arrow leaves; empty for a root, and for a parent with no name (note tpParentName)

generation.x-source: the layer of the pathway (tp-05: the longest directed path from a root, 0 for a root); empty for a structure no anchored arrow touches

smiles.x-source: the isomeric SMILES `save("smiles")` writes for that structure alone; empty when it is not written (note tpSmiles)

formula.x-source: Hill formula of the record, no charge, no count 1 (C10H14O)

monoisotopic_mass.x-source: engine `sel` (label.mass), 4 decimals; empty without the engine or when it refuses the structure (notes tpEngine, tpMass)

mz_calc.x-source: monoisotopic_mass plus the shift of the typed adduct, 4 decimals; only for the seven adducts of display.adducts and a neutral structure (notes tpAdduct, tpCharged)

ppm.x-source: (mz_obs - mz_calc) / mz_calc * 10^6 from the typed mz_obs and the PRINTED mz_calc, 1 decimal, -0.0 written 0.0

form_diff.x-source: the formula delta TP - parent of pathway:label (tp-07), spelling of mzlab_mol::delta::print (+O, -CH2, +O-H2); empty for an isomer and where there is no honest delta (note tpDelta); not guarded against spreadsheets

mass_diff.x-source: TP mass minus parent mass from the UNROUNDED masses, rounded once, 4 decimals, signed (+15.9949, -14.0157, 0.0000); can differ by 0.0001 from the difference of the printed masses

level.x-source: level of the current entry of the annotation of the structure, as written

notes.description: What the table left empty for a reason (nothing is dropped in silence): one item per key, in the order the keys first occur. The same keys with the counts are in `lost` of a draw-result/1 and on the page after the save.

items.description: the tp_id of each structure (`#` and its first atom id when it has none)

x-csv: The CSV has the header `tp_id,parent_id,...,identifier` on line 1 and one line per row. A text cell (tp_id, parent_id, adduct, level, identifier), and an mz_obs or rt that is not a number, that starts with =, +, -, @ or an apostrophe gets one more leading apostrophe (counted as the note draw2.export.tpGuard in `lost`, CSV only); the import takes one off again when one of those five characters follows, so export then import returns every cell unchanged. The CSV carries no notes: they are in `lost` of a draw-result/1 and on the page. It is read back by `import` as a list (tp_list::TABLE_COLUMNS): tp_id is the name, parent_id the parent, mz_obs the m/z, rows with one tp_id are one product with several parents, and the computed columns (generation, formula, monoisotopic_mass, mz_calc, ppm, form_diff, mass_diff) are not read.
